notes: South front on Cruquiusweg (surfaces 17 and 28, split by a notch in the 3DBAG footprint): a white rendered mass, blank above the second floor, two rows of square punched windows at floors 1-2, a glazed recessed ground floor behind columns with the INTERNATIONAAL INSTITUUT VOOR SOCIALE GESCHIEDENIS fascia, entrance at the top of the steps left of centre (ref-s).

North (Nieuwe Vaart, surface 23, 10.4 m): the lower block's ribbon window band; the curved upper mass above (surfaces 67/68) is blank, as in ref-n. The glazed corner stair and the curved roof edge are below the component grain; 3DBAG straightens the curve.
The colonnade, the steel light masts and the rooftop antennas are not modelled.
